title: Kentucky man becomes the first humanist granted religious exemption from AI
summary: A Kentucky man has become the first humanist to be granted a religious exemption from using AI, as reported by Religion News Service. The story gained significant attention on Hacker News with 473 points and 509 comments.
highlights: First humanist granted religious exemption from AI use
Kentucky man at center of precedent-setting case
High engagement on Hacker News (473 points, 509 comments)
